info.description: API for the Georgian housing-review platform.
info.title: Geo Housing Reviews API

parameters.description: Inclusive start of the window. Defaults to seven days ago, and is taken from the cursor when one is given.
parameters.name: since

parameters.description: Exclusive end of the window. To cover a whole calendar day, pass the start of the following day. Defaults to now.
parameters.name: until

parameters.description: Show only this account's actions. Absent means everyone's.
parameters.name: actor

parameters.description: Continue a previous page: pass back its nextCursor unchanged. The cursor carries the window and actor filter it came from; restating them is optional, but asking for different ones is refused rather than answered with a fragment of a different timeline.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: A page of the timeline, newest first.

400.description: The query cannot be answered as asked — an actor filter that is not an account id, a window that ends before it starts, or a cursor that cannot be read. The body names the parameter in fieldErrors.

parameters.description: Inclusive start of the window. Defaults to thirty days ago.
parameters.name: since

parameters.description: Exclusive end of the window. Defaults to now.
parameters.name: until

200.description: Queue depth as it stands, and throughput over the window.

400.description: The window ends before it starts.
